en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a broad, cobblestone street lined with ornate late 19th or early 20th-century European buildings. On the right, a building has a sign that reads 'TOBAK' (Swedish for 'tobacco') and a clock tower, while other storefronts and street lamps are visible further along the street. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Sundsvall, Storgatan from the west. The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text and a Swedish stamp featuring a portrait of a royal figure, cancelled in Sundsvall.
